Content: An oceanographic monitoring agency models the velocity `v(d)`, in `text(meters per second)`, of an open-ocean tsunami wave as a function of water depth `d`, in `text(meters)`, using the radical formula below.
:ibox:`v(d)=sqrt(9.8d-54)`
What is the value of `v(450)`, representing the speed of the wave in `text(meters per second)` at a depth of `text(450 meters)`?

A quality-assurance engineer monitors the deviation of an alloy engine block's cooling temperature from an ideal target of `text(75^°C)`. The penalty score `P(T)`, in quality points, as a function of the measured temperature `T`, in `text(degrees Celsius)`, is given by the following function.
What is the value of `P(61)`?
A specialized medical device manufacturer models the average cost per unit `C(x)`, in `text(dollars)`, of producing `x` diagnostic ultrasound probes using the rational function below.
What is the value of `C(100)`, representing the average unit production cost in `text(dollars)` when `100` probes are manufactured?

Accident reconstruction investigators estimate the initial speed `S(L)`, in `text(miles per hour)`, of a passenger sedan prior to braking based on the length of the skid marks `L`, in `text(feet)`, using the following square root formula.
:ibox:`S(L)=sqrt(16L+144)`
What is the value of `S(135)`, representing the estimated vehicle speed in `text(miles per hour)` for a `text(135-foot)` skid mark?

An environmental remediation team adds clean water to an industrial containment vat to dilute a chemical solute. The remaining concentration `K(v)`, in `text(grams per liter)` (`text(g/L)`), after adding `v` `text(liters)` of distilled water is modeled by the following function.
What is the value of `K(90)`?

An irrigation engineer models the outflow velocity `v(x)`, in `text(feet per second)`, of water exiting a pressurized nozzle at the base of a holding tank with the radical equation below, where `x` is the effective head height of the water column in `text(feet)`.
:ibox:`v(x)=sqrt(64x+100)`
If the required outflow velocity for the sprinkler system is exactly `text(26 feet per second)`, what is the value of `x`?

A boutique apparel company manufactures specialty winter jackets. The average production cost `text(per jacket)` `C(x)`, in `text(dollars)`, when producing a batch of `x` jackets is modeled by the following rational equation.
The company wants to scale production until the average cost drops to exactly `text($35 per jacket)`. How many jackets, `x`, must be produced in a batch to achieve this average cost?

An automated pharmaceutical bottling line monitors the fill volume `x`, in `text(milliliters)`, of liquid medication containers. An optical sensor assigns an error penalty index `E(x)` according to the equation below.
A container triggers a specific quality alert when `E(x)=35`. If the container is identified by the weight scale as being overfilled (`x>75`), what is the fill volume `x`, in `text(milliliters)`?
A transportation engineer calculates the safe design speed `S(x)`, in `text(miles per hour)`, for an unbanked circular highway off-ramp with a radius of `x` `text(feet)` using the following formula.
:ibox:`S(x)=sqrt(2.5x+225)`
If state highway guidelines mandate a safe design speed of `text(45 miles per hour)` for a new interchange ramp, what must be the radius of the ramp, `x`, in `text(feet)`?

An industrial settling pond uses `text(two)` drainage pumps to remove wastewater. Working alone, the primary high-capacity pump can completely drain the pond in `x` `text(hours)`. The secondary pump takes `(x+15)` `text(hours)` to drain the pond on its own. When both pumps operate simultaneously, they drain the entire pond in exactly `text(10 hours)` according to the combined work rate equation below.
What is the value of `x`, representing the time in `text(hours)` it takes the primary pump to drain the pond alone?
